name: Human Genetics & Genomic Medicine
summary: The genetics of people: Mendelian disease, complex traits, genetic testing, ancestry and how genomics is used in medicine.

topics.name: The human genome and patterns of human variation
Mendelian disorders: mechanisms and examples (cystic fibrosis, sickle cell, Huntington's)
Complex traits, heritability and genome-wide association studies (GWAS)
Polygenic risk scores: construction and limitations
Cancer genetics: germline predisposition versus somatic mutation
Genetic testing, newborn screening and prenatal diagnosis
Clinical exome/genome sequencing and variant interpretation
Genetic ancestry and forensic DNA profiling
Gene therapy in the clinic (overview) and genetic counselling
Ethical, legal and social implications of human genomics
